title: My agenda
description: Shared calendar of deadlines from contracts, leases, tasks, invoices, assets and operations, your notifications and own events (S13).

create.title: New event
create.description: Own calendar event (meeting, inspection, reminder). The assignee is notified.

event.derivedNote: This date is read from its source ({{source}}). Change it in the original record – the calendar shows the new date on the next load, without a second entry.

state.forbiddenDescription: You may not read this source, so it is neither shown nor counted.
state.unavailableDescription: The source is not responding. We do not show it as zero – try refreshing.
state.noDataDescription: The source holds no data needed for this figure.
state.agendaUnavailable: The calendar agenda is unavailable – own events and notifications are not shown.
state.readOnly: Read-only agenda: you see only the events assigned to you. Staff create and change events.

calendar.emptyDescription: Try another period or clear the filters.
calendar.readOnlyNote: The calendar only reads dates from the original records (contracts, leases, tasks, invoices, assets, operations). They are changed there; own events can be edited here.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.checkResult: New notifications: {{delivered}} · already delivered events skipped: {{duplicates}}
notifications.checkDescription: Each event with the same ID is shown only once.
notifications.explain: Opening the agenda or checking notifications loads your assigned tasks even without a due date, plus approaching and overdue deadlines from readable sources. Calendar event assignments and date changes are delivered on save. The same event is delivered only once.
notifications.readOnly: You can read notifications but not mark them (read-only permission).
notifications.emptyDescription: New notifications appear when a task or event is assigned to you or before a deadline.
notifications.emailPending: waiting to be sent by e-mail
notifications.emailFailed: the e-mail could not be sent

mine.intro: Deadlines, tasks and events assigned to {{who}}.
mine.noTasks: You have no open tasks with a due date.

settings.title: Notification settings
settings.leadDays: Notify about a deadline in advance
settings.emailReal: Notifications are really sent by e-mail ({{provider}}) to {{address}}. Only notifications created after switching on are sent; several at once go in one e-mail.
settings.emailNotConfigured: No e-mail server is configured yet: the preference is stored and e-mails start once an administrator configures one. Until then notifications are in-app only.
settings.emailUnknown: The e-mail service cannot be checked right now; in-app notifications keep working and e-mails go out once the service is reachable.
settings.emailEvents: Which events to send by e-mail
settings.optionalHint: Assignments and overdue deadlines are always e-mailed; upcoming deadlines and changes as you choose.

exportsLog.title: Export log
exportsLog.emptyDescription: Every CSV export from the calendar, overview and search is recorded here (who, when, what, how many rows).

search.label: Search records
search.placeholder: Search property, unit, tenant, contract, invoice, task, device…
search.scope: Only records you may read are searched ({{count}} records).
search.hidden: Sources you cannot access are not searched: {{sources}}.
search.emptyDescription: Try another term; accents and letter case do not matter.

occupancy.label: Occupancy today
occupancy.definition: Share of active units with an active lease or stay today, out of all active units. Reservations (confirmed future leases) do not count as occupied.

properties.label: Active properties
properties.definition: Number of properties in state Active. Disposed and inactive ones are not counted; the drill-down lists exactly the counted properties.

leases.label: Active leases
leases.definition: Active leases running today (start on or before today, end after today). The drill-down shows exactly the counted records; future confirmed leases are a separate supporting figure.

overdueInvoices.label: Overdue invoices
overdueInvoices.definition: Confirmed, non-voided invoices (issued and received) that are not fully paid and whose due date is before today (Europe/Prague). Drafts are not counted.

openTasks.label: Open tasks
openTasks.definition: Tasks in state New, In progress or Waiting. “Overdue” = due before today.

incidents.label: Open incidents
incidents.definition: Unresolved incidents and faults from the site-operations agendas (e.g. security). Requires access to internal operations agendas.

deadlines.label: Deadlines in 30 days
deadlines.definition: Open deadlines in the next 30 days from every source you may read: contract ends and notice dates, lease starts and ends, tasks, invoice due dates, asset and device inspections, meter readings and own events.

contracts.label: Contracts ending within 60 days
contracts.definition: Active contracts whose end date is within 60 days from today (or already past).

salesCases.label: Open sales cases
salesCases.definition: Opportunities from Lead to Negotiation that are not won, lost or archived. Amounts excl. VAT; weighted = amount × probability.

planActual.label: Plan vs. actual (costs this year)
planActual.definition: Finance budget lines from January to the current month. Actual = the manually confirmed amount of the line, otherwise confirmed invoices of the same month, category, direction and object. Value = actual costs / planned costs.

overview.title: Operations overview
overview.description: Key figures from governed sources, upcoming deadlines and search across the records you may read (S15).
overview.summary: Today {{today}} deadlines, next 7 days {{week}}, overdue {{overdue}}. Unread notifications: {{unread}}.
overview.zeroConfirmed: The source is available and holds no matching record today – so the zero is real.
overview.noUpcomingDescription: The sources you may read hold no open future deadlines.
